# GroundTruth — 2026 US Tariff & Landed-Cost Data

> Source-linked US import duty rates, MPF/HMF fees and total landed cost by product and origin country. Updated 2026-10-01. Planning estimates, not a CBP entry.

## What is this site
Real 2026 US customs duty data broken down by:
- **Product**: 209 concrete products across 13 categories (apparel, electronics, steel, solar, batteries, auto, toys, jewelry, semiconductors, lumber, general)
- **Origin**: China (CN), Vietnam (VN), India (IN), Mexico (MX), Other
- **Fee layers**: MFN rate + Section 301 (China) + Section 232 (national security) + forced-labor base

## Key pages
- [Home](https://contentforge-press.github.io/us-tariff-data/): Browse all products and origins
- [Guides](https://contentforge-press.github.io/us-tariff-data/guides.html): MPF, HMF, Section 301/232, landed cost explainers
- [HTS chapters](https://contentforge-press.github.io/us-tariff-data/hts-chapters.html): Duty rates by HTS chapter
- [Free calculator](https://contentforge-press.github.io/groundtruth-calculator/): Browser-based landed cost calculator
- [API & MCP](https://dytsk9wrfv.page.coze.site/groundtruth.html): Live API for AI agents and apps

## Tariff rate structure (2026)
Each product page shows the stacked duty rate:
1. MFN (normal trade) rate — base WTO rate
2. Section 301 — additional 25% on most China-origin goods
3. Section 232 — national security duty on steel (50%), autos (25%), semiconductors (25%), lumber (10%)
4. Forced-labor / security base — 12.5% on China, 12.5% on Vietnam, 10% on India/Mexico/Other
5. MPF — 0.3% of value (min $34.58, max $670.86)
6. HMF — 0.1% of value, ocean freight only

## API access
- REST: GET https://winter-river-47fc.contentforge-press.workers.dev/v1/tariff?product_description=&origin_code=CN&declared_value=1000 (requires x-api-key)
- Free trial: GET https://winter-river-47fc.contentforge-press.workers.dev/try?product_description=cotton+t-shirt&origin_code=CN&declared_value=100 (no key, 200/day/IP)
- MCP: POST https://winter-river-47fc.contentforge-press.workers.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP, anonymous rate-limited)
- OpenAPI: GET https://winter-river-47fc.contentforge-press.workers.dev/openapi.json

## Data sources
- HTS codes: https://hts.usitc.gov/
- China tariff rates: https://www.tariffstool.com/guides/china-tariff-rate
- MPF/HMF fees: https://blogs.tradlinx.com/cbp-customs-fees-rise-on-october-1-heres-what-actually-changes/
- CBP guidelines: https://www.cbp.gov/trade/basic-import-export/importer-examination-forms-and-guidelines

## Licenses / attribution
Free with attribution. Paid plans remove attribution requirement.
